storage: Airtight jar or the closed pack in a cool, dry cupboard; use a dry spoon.
looksLike: A dark red-brown ground blend with a smoky, tangy-warm smell, sold in 50 g and 100 g cartons.
howToPick: Pick a sealed carton with a clear ingredient list, a deep red-brown colour and a rich smell; avoid faded, clumped or damp packs. Check the label if you need it gluten-free, as blends can include fillers.
shelfLife: Typically 6 to 12 months in the sealed pack (general guidance; check the pack's best-before). (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run)
substitutes: Garam masala plus a little coriander powder, red chilli powder and dry mango powder (amchur)
